entities.name: Developer
entities.rationale: Icon of group of people labeled DEVELOPER at bottom-left (left of the dashed vertical divider). Developers create code and push to Git.

entities.name: Git
entities.rationale: Cylinder icon labeled GIT, left of the dashed divider. External Git repository with webhooks connected to Lagoon.

entities.name: Lagoon EKS
entities.rationale: Orange EKS icon labeled LAGOON above and EKS below, left of the dashed vertical divider. Lagoon core application delivery platform runs on EKS.

entities.name: Hosting Zone EKS
entities.rationale: Orange EKS icon at top of the right side of the dashed divider (hosting zones). Cluster where developer environments are deployed; sits above EC2 and EC2 Spot.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: EC2 instances icon labeled EC2, right side under hosting EKS. Base workload worker nodes for EKS.

entities.name: EC2 Spot
entities.rationale: EC2 Spot icon labeled EC2 SPOT, right side under hosting EKS. Spot worker nodes for dev/non-production workloads.

entities.name: Aurora R6G
entities.rationale: Blue Aurora icon labeled AURORA R6G at bottom row of the right side. Databases provisioned by an operator, on Graviton2 R6G instances.

entities.name: EBS GP3
entities.rationale: Green EBS icon labeled EBS GP3 at bottom row of the right side. Volumes for specialized workloads like databases or search servers.

entities.name: EFS
entities.rationale: Green EFS icon labeled EFS at bottom-right. File storage for normal assets.

visual_connections.description: Pink upward arrow from DEVELOPER to GIT: developers push code to Git repositories.
Pink arrow from GIT to LAGOON EKS: webhooks notify Lagoon.
Pink arrow from LAGOON EKS pointing right to the dashed divider / hosting zone side: Lagoon deploys to the hosting zones' EKS.
Pink arrow down-left from EKS to EC2: base workloads run on EC2 instances.
Pink arrow down-right from EKS to EC2 SPOT: non-production workloads on Spot.
Pink arrow down-left from EC2 to AURORA R6G: database provisioned for workloads.
Pink arrow down-left from EC2 SPOT to EBS GP3: block storage volumes.
Pink arrow down-right from EC2 SPOT to EFS: file storage for assets.
